# shopify_metafield_definition (Resource)

A metafield definition. Optional attributes left unset are not managed, so admin edits to them are kept. Import with `OWNER_TYPE/namespace/key`, e.g. `PRODUCT/custom/material`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "shopify_metafield_definition" "care_level" {
  owner_type  = "PRODUCT"
  namespace   = "custom"
  key         = "care_level"
  name        = "Care level"
  description = "Relevant care level for the product"
  type        = "number_integer"

  validations = {
    min = "1"
    max = "5"
  }

  access = {
    storefront = "PUBLIC_READ"
  }

  pin = true

  # Destroying or replacing deletes all stored values; opt in explicitly when needed.
  allow_data_deletion = false

  lifecycle {
    prevent_destroy = true
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Key within the namespace. Changing it forces replacement.
- `name` (String) Human-readable name.
- `namespace` (String) Namespace, e.g. `custom`. Changing it forces replacement.
- `owner_type` (String) Owner resource type, e.g. `PRODUCT`. Changing it forces replacement.
- `type` (String) Metafield type, e.g. `number_integer` or `list.single_line_text_field`. Changing it forces replacement.

### Optional

- `access` (Attributes) API access settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--access))
- `allow_data_deletion` (Boolean) Allow destroying or replacing this metafield definition, which deletes the data stored in it. Defaults to `false`. Must already be `true` in state when the delete runs, so set it in a separate apply first.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `pin` (Boolean) Pin the definition in the admin.
- `use_as_collection_condition` (Boolean) Allow use in smart collection conditions. Shopify blocks deletion while a collection uses it.
- `validations` (Map of String) Validation name to value, e.g. `{ min = "1" }`. JSON-shaped values are passed as JSON strings.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Metafield definition GID.

<a id="nestedatt--access"></a>
### Nested Schema for `access`

Optional:

- `admin` (String) `MERCHANT_READ` or `MERCHANT_READ_WRITE`.
- `customer_account` (String) `READ_WRITE`, `READ` or `NONE`.
- `storefront` (String) `PUBLIC_READ` or `NONE`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <OWNER_TYPE>/<namespace>/<key>
terraform import shopify_metafield_definition.care_level PRODUCT/custom/care_level
```
